title: dismiss_claim input
description: Records that a found item is not a business application, with the reason. Reversible: undo moves the claim back to open.

reason.description: Why it is not a business application, or why the dismissal is undone.

reasonKey.description: From the dismiss reason value list.

undo.description: True moves a dismissed claim back to open.

examples.reason: A personal test app with no users.
